SEO SERVICES PRICING

How Much Does SEO Cost Per Month in the UK?

Compare common monthly SEO pricing models in the UK and learn what to check before choosing a provider.

By Cyberfreak Software · 28 November 2026

Why monthly SEO prices vary

A monthly quote is only useful when you know what work it buys. One provider may charge for technical audits and implementation; another may focus on content, digital PR or local search. These are different services, so comparing the headline fee alone can lead to the wrong conclusion. Ask for the activities, frequency and responsibilities behind the number.

What affects the fee?

The size and condition of a website, the number of locations or services, the competitiveness of its market and the amount of implementation required can all affect the work involved. A small brochure site with a stable structure does not need the same programme as a large online shop. A provider should explain which factors apply to your situation rather than selling a package that assumes every business has identical needs.

What does £125 a month cover?

Cyberfreak Software offers a defined SEO Management service for £125 per month. It includes Google Search Console setup and verification, XML sitemap submission and maintenance, monitoring of clicks, impressions and indexed pages, query and keyword opportunity analysis, practical content recommendations and a monthly performance report. Subscriptions have no minimum term and can be cancelled at any time. Content writing, major technical changes and bespoke development are not included in that fee; they can be discussed separately.

Compare scope, not promises

Ask whether the quote includes implementation or recommendations only, who makes website changes, how progress is measured, what happens when an issue is found and whether the contract renews automatically. Be cautious of guarantees about rankings or a specific amount of traffic. Search performance depends on many factors and no responsible provider can promise a precise result for every site.

Choose a useful starting point

If you need a clearly scoped, lower-commitment way to keep an eye on your search foundations, review our SEO Management pricing and deliverables. If your needs extend to content production or development, ask for those items to be priced separately so the boundaries stay clear.
